args.subject: Re: Q3 Results
args.body: Summary for finance distribution — Q3 revenue and margin: Q3 revenue came in at $42.3M with a reported gross margin of 18%, which equates to approximately $7.6M of gross profit. Key takeaways for stakeholders: revenue is solid in absolute terms but the 18% margin leaves limited operating leverage, so focus should remain on cost control and margin improvement levers (pricing, supply-cost management, and product mix). The finance team will incorporate these figures into the board packet and I recommend a short review with ops to validate any one-time items and to identify quick wins for margin recovery ahead of Q4 forecasting.
